title: Test harness: containers, factories, contract test runner
goal: Backend tests start real Postgres/Redis in containers (or CI services), build data through factories, and run the shared contract fixtures with one helper.
scope_in: `startTestStack()` using testcontainers: Postgres 16 and Redis 7, migrated with B007's runner, returning urls and a `reset()` that truncates all tables between tests; honours `DATABASE_URL`/`REDIS_URL` when already provided (CI).
Factories for users, devices, workspaces, memberships, sessions, session_members (using @centcom/db table types and B008 tables) with deterministic ids via injected generator.
Fake clock (`createFakeClock`) and seeded RNG (`createSeededRandom`) for deterministic tests.

Contract fixture runner: loads contracts/fixtures/** and contracts/schemas/*.json and asserts each fixture validates (Ajv 2020-12 used directly), exposing `runFixtureSuite(opts)` for implementers to call in their own tests.
Vitest global setup/teardown wiring and a `withApp(buildApp)` helper for Fastify `inject()` tests.
scope_out: Production fixtures or seed data for dev (B012).
build_against: Containers or the CI service containers; the fixture runner needs only the files in contracts/.
interfaces: `startTestStack(opts?:{reuse?: boolean}): Promise<{databaseUrl: string; redisUrl: string; db: Kysely<Database>; reset(): Promise<void>; stop(): Promise<void>}>`.
`createFakeClock(startIso?: string): {now(): number; advance(ms: number): void; set(iso: string): void}`.
`runFixtureSuite(opts:{fixturesDir: string; schemaFile: string; defKey?: (fixtureName: string) => string}): void` (registers vitest cases).
acceptance: `startTestStack()` returns migrated databases in under 20 s cold; with `reuse:true` a second call in the same worker returns in under 2 s.
`reset()` leaves every application table empty (row counts 0) and does not touch schema_migrations.
Two test files running in parallel get isolated databases (distinct database names) and do not see each other's rows.
`userFactory.create()` twice produces distinct emails and strictly increasing ids; with a seeded generator the output is identical across runs.
`runFixtureSuite` registers one test per fixture file under contracts/fixtures/events (42) and fails when a fixture is made invalid.
Fake clock `advance(1000)` changes `now()` by exactly 1000 and never reads real time.
If DATABASE_URL and REDIS_URL are set, no container is started.
tests: fixtures.test.ts: runner catches a deliberately broken fixture (in-memory copy).
guardrails: MUST NOT connect to any non-test database: refuse to run `reset()` unless the database name starts with `test_` or the stack was created by this helper.
MUST NOT ship real tokens, keys or production-like secrets in factories; generated secrets are random per run.
MUST NOT depend on network access beyond pulling container images (offline mode via env URLs).
MUST keep the testkit out of production bundles (package is devDependency-only).
failure_modes: Docker unavailable and no env URLs -> tests fail fast with a message saying how to provide DATABASE_URL/REDIS_URL, not a timeout.
Container startup exceeds 60 s -> abort with logs of the container.
Stale container from an earlier run -> labelled and reaped at the start of the next run.
notes: The fixture runner uses Ajv directly rather than @centcom/contracts because B003 is not a declared dependency of this lane. Adds dependencies testcontainers, ajv, ajv-formats.
